title: Google’s AlphaGenome 2 zooms in on the cellular roots of disease
summary: Google DeepMind has unveiled AlphaGenome 2, an AI model designed to predict how genetic variants affect specific cell types and states. This advanced model was trained on over 100 million individual cell profiles across 68 tissues, enabling it to identify nearly twice as many gene expression-changing variants as previous state-of-the-art models. By providing a finer-grained view of genetic impacts at the cellular level, AlphaGenome 2 could accelerate the discovery of disease causes and lead to the development of new, targeted treatments.
image_alt: A pipeline shows broad genetic variants entering an AI model, leading to specific cellular effects for disease understanding.

title: DeepL unveils Aure, its most lifelike Voice AI translation model yet
summary: DeepL has unveiled Aure, its most dynamic and lifelike Voice AI model, marking a significant advancement in real-time cross-language communication. Aure continuously adapts translated speech to reflect shifts in tone, emotion, emphasis, and pace, building on previous voice preservation technology that maintained a speaker's recognizable voice. This innovation captures more of the speaker's personality and nuance, enabling more natural and impactful human expression across different languages by moving beyond static voice samples.
image_alt: A comparison showing how DeepL's Aure AI moves from static voice capture to continuous analysis, resulting in more dynamic and expressive real-time voice translation.

title: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
summary: Google has launched Tabletop AI, an experimental tool that generates customized collaborative hubs for personal use. Users can describe desired interactive tools, such as savings trackers, chore charts, or event plans, or select from starter templates, allowing the AI to create personalized spaces similar to workplace management apps. This development offers families and friends a user-friendly alternative to complex business software for coordinating activities and planning, making personal organization more accessible and tailored.
image_alt: A pipeline showing a user's text description flowing into an AI, which then generates a custom collaborative application.

title: Nvidia is reportedly preparing to fire Jensen Huang
summary: Nvidia's board is reportedly preparing to dismiss CEO Jensen Huang following a New York Times report detailing a second alleged extramarital affair with an executive who reports to him. This development comes days after Huang admitted to a separate affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy, prompting an internal investigation. The unfolding scandal has led to a more than 7 percent drop in Nvidia's stock and signals significant leadership instability as the board meets to decide Huang's future.
image_alt: A pipeline diagram illustrates how multiple affair allegations trigger a corporate board review, leading to a CEO's departure from leadership.

title: Adobe’s AI experiments let you walk around in photos and interview your characters
summary: Adobe has unveiled experimental AI tools that transform flat images into explorable 3D environments and enable conversational creation of AI characters. Project Sight Span converts any 2D image into a navigable 3D space, generating out-of-frame content, while Project Screen Test allows users to define character personalities and behaviors through direct conversation. These innovations offer artists enhanced creative control, promising more immersive visual experiences and consistent, personality-rich AI-generated content for future media production.
image_alt: A branching diagram illustrating how a flat image can become an explorable 3D scene, and how conversational input defines an AI character.

title: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
summary: United Airlines has announced it will not permit personal AI assistants to book flights on its platform, citing significant privacy and regulatory concerns. The airline highlights issues such as AI agents being unable to attest to federal security requirements, like confirming bags are free of explosives, and the potential for exposing customer data or making unintended purchases. This decision, mirrored by other businesses, could limit the practical utility of emerging personal AI assistants by preventing them from completing transactions on behalf of users.
image_alt: Diagram showing an AI agent attempting to access an airline booking system but being blocked, preventing transaction completion.

title: AI Customer Driven Development
summary: A new model proposes AI-driven customer development, allowing users to directly request and enable features within software applications. Customers type desired features into settings; AI either activates existing public toggles, suggests related hidden features, or, if new, forwards the request for human review before AI agents implement, test, and document the new functionality behind a public toggle. This approach aims to combat feature bloat by personalizing software experiences, making products more adaptable to individual user needs without compromising usability for others.
image_alt: A pipeline showing a customer request flowing to AI development, which then creates custom features in an application.

title: Google gooses Python AI performance by... removing Python
summary: Google has reportedly enhanced its Python AI performance by implementing a method that involves removing Python from certain processes. Only the headline-level development is known, indicating a strategy to optimize AI operations by altering the underlying programming language environment to achieve performance gains. This suggests a potential shift in how Google approaches its AI infrastructure, aiming for greater efficiency and speed in its machine learning applications, which could impact development practices.
image_alt: A diagram showing Python code being removed from a process, resulting in faster AI performance.
